statements.status_notes: RUSTSEC-2026-0204 is an invalid pointer dereference in the fmt::Pointer implementation for Atomic and Shared in crossbeam-epoch 0.9.x before 0.9.20. crossbeam-epoch appears in the SBOM because the Cargo.lock of flux v0.201.0 lists it, but it is not compiled into Kapacitor. Its only dependent in the lock file is crossbeam-deque, which comes in through rayon-core and rayon. flux-core declares rayon as an optional dependency that only its `doc` feature enables. criterion, a dev-dependency of flux and flux-core, also depends on rayon, but `cargo build` does not build dev-dependencies. Kapacitor builds libflux with `cargo build --release --no-default-features --features=cffi`, and flux v0.201.0 depends on flux-core with default-features = false, so `doc` is off. The amd64 kapacitord binary contains no symbols from the crossbeam_epoch or crossbeam_deque crate, while the crates that are compiled in (anyhow, chrono, libflate, parking_lot_core) do.
